sloka: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा वायसं समवैक्षथाः ।नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ।। ५.६७.९ ।।।।
transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā vāyasaṁ samavaikṣathāḥ ।nakhaiḥ sarudhiraistīkṣṇaistāmevābhimukhaṁ sthitam ।। 5.67.9 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Seeing all over, at once I glanced at the crow that stood in front of her with sharp bloodstained nails'.
